sources.snippet: Abstract Self-supervised bioacoustic encoders have been used for species classification but so far have not addressed syllable-level structure in birdsong. We introduce SongMAE, a compact MAE-ViT (Masked Autoencoder Vision Transformer) that operates on mel spectrograms with 2 ms temporal resolution. sources.title: SongMAE: Biosignals model | bio.rodeo
sources.snippet: SongMAE is a ViT encoder-decoder over 128-bin log-mel spectrograms computed at 32 kHz with a 1,024-sample FFT, a 32 ms Hann window and a 160-sample hop. A shallow convolutional stack precedes the transformer; the decoder is discarded after pretraining.

sources.title: SongMAE: A bioacoustic encoder for birdsong - labs.sciety.org
sources.snippet: The architecture of existing self-supervised bioacoustic encoders has largely been inherited from human speech models; as a result, these encoders operate at temporal resolutions designed for human speech.
